name: Azure Blob Storage
line: Store unstructured files in Microsoft Azure.

free.text: 5 GB Hot storage for 12 months; free account may disable after 30 days

cells.metered: Pay for storage, operations, and data transfer

files.math: 100 GB of storage at $0.0208 per GB a month, plus 10 × $0.05 for writes and 100 × $0.004 for reads, which are billed by blocks of requests. The first 100 GB of internet outbound data each month is free.
